issue.title: W9 — GitHub on demand and links
issue.body:
Planned; remains open.

Already available: manual crew URLs and terminal hyperlinks. Still needed: the on-demand GitHub integration and actions below. Resolve distinguishable selected/all refresh bindings; R and Shift+R are the same terminal key.

## Scope

Branch/compare/PR browser actions and OSC 8; issue lookup at spawn,
Issue.* template data, crew suggestions/title fetch; PR refresh/menu; open-PR
warning on retire.

## Acceptance

- [ ] gh behind an interface with fake-gh tests; features tolerate absent gh.
- [ ] Pass the standard test, vet, lint and platform-build gates; update usage/help and delivery notes.

Implement as its own usable slice after W8, following the roadmap's checkpoint workflow.

Source: [W9 roadmap](https://github.com/thomashartm/motley/blob/a2ac75b9894fd2d8d72e76fe3c82fe2ba792fc0e/REQUIREMENTS.md#L839).
